lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuHgAsP crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Cu4Hg4As4P4) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu centers with 8 neighbors (2 As, 2 Cu, 4 P), As centers with 11 neighbors (3 Cu, 1 Hg, 7 P), and P centers with 5 neighbors (2 As, 2 Cu, 1 Hg). Hg centers display two distinct 4-neighbor environments. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between As 11-vertex and Cu 8-vertex polyhedra.
